title: Getting started with Ground Link
body:
Welcome to Ground Link, the satellite pass planner from Orbitwell Systems.
Before you begin, ask your administrator for an ORBITWELL account key.
For help, contact the Orbitwell support team.

title: Release notes 3.2
body:
Fixed pass-prediction drift (OWS-142).
Updated the OrbSys-compatible export format.
Known issue: OWS-155 affects exports larger than 2 GB.

title: New starter checklist
body:
1. Request access to the Orbitwell Systems wiki.
2. Introduce yourself to the Orbit Systems Engineering team.
3. The ground team maintains orbit systems dashboards for satellite trajectory data; ask them for a walkthrough.

title: Embedded platform notes
body:
Supported operating systems: Linux and Windows.
The firmware targets embedded systems and real-time systems.
See the systems design guide for details.
